topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Finding my old teddy bear at a yard sale was like stumbling upon a piece of my heart, tattered and worn but unmistakably mine. The familiar softness of his fur, the gentle curve of his stitched nose, each reminded me of countless nights he stood watch over my dreams. Holding him, it’s as if the years melted away, and for a moment, I was back in that safe, small world. The other shoppers must have seen something in my face, for no one rushed me at the counter. I paid the few dollars asked, clutching him a bit tighter as I did. It’s not just a teddy bear; it’s a gentle embrace from a time long past, a silent guardian returned to watch over me once more.
